# Dependencies of the Tooling repository itself on macOS. The lint and
# the format gates need the two CPAN modules, and the secret gate needs
# gitleaks (MK-GITLEAKS-4).
test cpan Perl::Critic
test cpan Perl::Tidy
tool bin gitleaks https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v8.30.1/gitleaks_8.30.1_{os}_{arch}.tar.gz gitleaks
